name: Security Construct
languages: understands the languages of its creator but can't speak
description: Emerging from the warped thresholds of the Aberrant Core, the Security Construct stands as a grim sentinel forged from a fusion of ancient dwarven craftsmanship and aberrant bio-metallic mutation. Towering and humanoid, its frame is a jagged silhouette of blackened iron plates fused with pulsating veins of sickly flesh and glowing, eldritch circuitry. Its eyes burn with a cold, unyielding azure light that pierces the shifting shadows of the Warped Sentinel Vestibule. The construct's limbs end in multifaceted, claw-like appendages, humming softly with latent psychic energy, capable of emitting disorienting pulses that fracture the perceptions of intruders. Its surface is mottled with scorched runes and corroded sigils, half-melted as if exposed to otherworldly heat, while the joints twitch with a subtle, unsettling life, as if the machine itself breathes uneasily between moments of mechanical precision. Around it, the air shimmers lightly with static, and faint echoes of whispered warnings ripple through the warped geometry of the chamber. The construct moves with an unnerving blend of relentless mechanical purpose and twitching, almost organic reflexes, its awareness tethered to ancient protocols corrupted by the aberrant energies suffusing the place. It guards its domain not just with brute force but with a creeping psychic unease, a living nightmare in metal and flesh that warns: intrusion here invites oblivion.
